caption:
Most people are so worried about burnout to the point where they don’t even try. 

You want an above average life? Make above average and unrealistic and delusional decisions.

title: Unrealistic Effort Is the Price of Entry
one_liner: Building a top-income business requires short-term unsustainable sacrifices most people refuse to make.
key_points: Posted 3x/day on multiple pages for 6 straight months while working 50–55 hour weeks
Reached $150K/month by making decisions 99.9% of people won't make
Short-term unsustainability is a feature, not a flaw — you don't have to do it forever
Anyone telling you to stay comfortable is keeping you from exceptional results
